_help: Fill in the fields below for the showing you want to watch. See README section 'Filling in config.json'.
_theatresNote: Any theatre in this list is watched. Each needs the theatre's OWN showtimes page (not a movie's cross-theatre listing page — that needs geolocation and doesn't work standalone).
_autoDiscoverNote: When enabled, the watcher re-discovers real showtime ids itself (see src/discover.js) for a rolling window, instead of a hand-maintained list — no more manually copying seat URLs or refreshing stale ids.
_scheduleFilterNote: Narrows discovered showtimes down to a preferred weekly schedule. Days are 0=Sun..6=Sat. A value can be an exact-hour list (e.g. [6,10,14,18,22] — ONLY those hours) or a range {min, max} (e.g. {min:18} = 6pm onwards, any minute, no upper bound). Current rule: weekdays (Mon-Fri) 6pm onwards (any time after, not just on-the-hour slots), Sat/Sun unrestricted from 6am onwards.
_cadenceNote: The AMC seat-selection page (/seats) is much more aggressively rate-limited than other AMC pages — repeated live testing got temporarily banned (Cloudflare Error 1015) after only a handful of rapid requests, with the ban duration growing each time. The numbers below are conservative starting points based on limited testing, NOT a confirmed-safe rate. Lower them carefully and watch the logs for '[block]' lines.
_formatNote: true = only showings matching "format" above (IMAX 70MM) qualify.
